forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M1MNYZXP3TFQPKTCAK4RQ6AB
+- 01M1MP3120PZBY1VSH0GC7QQ26
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9480'
+title: 'README: correct the memory floor and the model names'
+---
+### What
+
+cli-plan.md §7 changes the default profile and moves the memory floor
+from 16 GB to 32 GB. `README.md` states the old figure and the old
+models, so it is now wrong. A person reads the README before anything
+else, and a wrong memory figure sends them into a resolution failure.
+
+In `README.md`:
+
+- [ ] Replace the 16 GB figure with 32 GB, wherever it appears.
+- [ ] Replace the Qwen2.5 model names with the new defaults of §7.
+- [ ] Add the `acp-agent` command surface: `run`, `acp`, `config`,
+      `instructions` and `doctor`, with one line each.
+- [ ] Say that the first run downloads the models, and that
+      `acp-agent doctor` reports the size before you start.
+
+**`plan.md` is not edited.** cli-plan.md §12 records which document
+governs each item, on purpose. This task touches `README.md` only.
+
+### Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] No "16 GB" remains in `README.md`.
+- [ ] No `Qwen2.5` model name remains in `README.md`.
+- [ ] Each subcommand of cli-plan.md §5.3 appears in the README.
+- [ ] `plan.md` is unchanged. `git diff plan.md` is empty.
+
+### Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/DocumentationSyncTests.swift`
+      gains a case: every model reference the README names equals the
+      matching default in `ProfileConfiguration`. A future default
+      change with no README change fails the test.
+- [ ] The same test asserts the README holds no "16 GB" string.
+- [ ] A test asserts that every subcommand name of the command tree
+      appears in `README.md`, so a new subcommand cannot ship
+      undocumented.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter DocumentationSyncTests` passes.
+
+### Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
